span.normalized: The majority of our products are marketed and sold around the world, including primarily in China, Japan, Singapore, and Taiwan, and our corporate operations are primarily located in Taiwan. Two outside foundries, primarily Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (“TSMC”), and secondarily Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (“SMIC”), fabricate our semiconductors. Accordingly, we are subject to the risks generally associated with global trade and doing business abroad, which include foreign laws and regulations, varying consumer preferences across geographic regions, political unrest, disruptions or delays in cross-border shipments and changes in economic conditions in countries in which our products are manufactured or where we sell products.
